name: Deno Kv
composeYaml:
services:
  denokv:
    image: 'ghcr.io/denoland/denokv:latest'
    environment:
      - 'ACCESS_TOKEN=${DENOKV_PASSWORD}'
    volumes:
      - '${COOLIFY_VOLUME_APP}:/data'
    command: '--sqlite-path /data/denokv.sqlite serve --access-token ${DENOKV_PASSWORD}'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - nc
        - '-zv'
        - 127.0.0.1
        - '4512'
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
